description: This source file contains a base test class 'ProgrammaticSubscribeTestsRunner' with various test methods for stream subscription, production, and consumption in Orleans testing environment. It also includes a helper class 'SubscriptionManager' for managing stream subscriptions within tests.

classes.name: ProgrammaticSubscribeTestsRunner
classes.description: Abstract base class for stream subscription tests using Orleans, encapsulating various test cases for subscribing, unsubscribing, and handling multiple streams and providers.

classes.name: SubscriptionManager
classes.description: Helper class to manage stream subscriptions within tests, facilitating setup, addition, retrieval, and removal of subscriptions.

methods.name: Programmatic_Subscribe_Provider_WithExplicitPubsub_TryGetStreamSubscrptionManager
methods.description: Test method to verify obtaining a subscription manager for a specific stream provider.

methods.name: Programmatic_Subscribe_CanUseNullNamespace
methods.description: Test method for subscribing to a stream with a null namespace.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_Subscribe
methods.description: Test for setting up subscriptions, creating producer and consumer grains, starting production, and verifying message flow.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_UnSubscribe
methods.description: Test for unsubscribing a consumer during stream production and verifying the resulting consumer behavior.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_GetSubscriptions
methods.description: Test for retrieving current subscriptions and verifying their correctness after modifications.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_ConsumerUnsubscribeOnAdd
methods.description: Test for verifying consumers automatically unsubscribe when new consumers are added.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_SubscribeToTwoStream_MessageWithPolymorphism
methods.description: Test for subscribing consumers to multiple streams and verifying message production to each stream.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer_SubscribeToStreamsHandledByDifferentStreamProvider
methods.description: Test for handling subscriptions and productions across different stream providers.

methods.name: ProducerHasProducedSinceLastCheck
methods.description: Utility for checking if producer has produced since last check, with assertion capability.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Utility to verify that produced message count matches consumed count, logging the counts.

methods.name: SetupStreamingSubscriptionForStream
methods.description: Sets up multiple subscriptions for a particular stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a specific grain to a stream.

methods.name: RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes a specific subscription from a stream.
